text:
alex: Heads-up — I'm hitting a perf regression when enabling fused RoPE in the fused-attn kernel on long sequences (>2048) with KV cache warmups. Throughput drops ~18% vs flashattn-v2 on our P4 testbed.

sree: ugh. which variant? fused-rope vs rotary post-process?

alex: fused-rope (rotary fused into attention kernel). rotary_dim=64, scale_variant=linear by default. Batching: max_batch=64, dynamic_batching=on. Observed when prefix cache hit rate > 70%.

maria: can you paste the perf numbers / profile?

alex: posted quick snapshot:
```
model: legacy-chat-small
seq: 3072
rotary_dim: 64
kernel: fused-attn (fused-rope on)
throughput: 820 tokens/s
compare: flashattn-v2 (rotary applied in kernel arg) => 1000 tokens/s
alloc: peak 9.1GB -> similar
latency p95: +14%
cpu-side: more time in kernel_select path (branching)
```

jon: interesting that kernel_select is more costly — maybe we added extra checks for fused-rope compatibility?

kevin: There's been a recent change that checks rotary_dim alignment and toggles paged-attention fallback. If fused-rope path requires contiguous rotary dims (multiple of 64) and we hit odd dims, we do an extra memcpy. Could be that.

sree: if memcpy triggers, then KV cache warmups could amplify overhead — every request with cache hit still pays memcpy per layer.

perf-bot: Benchmark run 1752001300:
```
bench: fused-attn:fused-rope ON vs flashattn-v2
HW: p4d.16xlarge-sim
batch=32,seq=3072,rotary_dim=64
fused-attn:fused-rope -> 820 tok/s
flashattn-v2            -> 1000 tok/s
paged-attn (rotary in host)-> 930 tok/s
notes: fused-rope shows lower mem copies but extra branch overhead in kernel selection path when cache_hits>0.
```

maria: Do we have GPU profiling traces (nsight) showing where time goes? Kernel-level metrics?

alex: yes, nvprof show extra device->device memcpy calls between MV kernels in the attention prep stage for the fused-rope path. Also more divergent warp activity in layer 10-20 which correlates with rotary_dim placement in model.

jon: So hypothesis: fused RoPE kernel optimized for contiguous rotary dims and calling convention, but our model's rotary dims distribution + KV cache paged layout causes misalignment => kernel_select emits memcpy and falls back to a less efficient launch config.

kevin: Another angle: batching heuristics. When dynamic_batching groups short warmup requests with long live requests, kernel_select toggles between flashattn-paged and fused-attn leading to more kernel switches. Kernel launches cost becomes visible at high concurrency.

alex: agreed. I also saw an increase in small kernel launches count (+30%) with fused-rope on. That explains some latency increase.

maria: Action suggestions:
- Add a lightweight rotary-dim alignment fastpath check in the runtime to avoid memcpy if possible.
- Emit per-request kernel_choice tag into trace for better aggregation.
- Add canary to disable fused-rope by default for seq>2048 until we root cause.

jon: +1. Also add a batch-splitting heuristic: prefer homogenous batches by rotary_dim and seq_len when possible. It's cheap and avoids kernel switching.

kevin: I can add a flag `runtime.attn.force_kernel=fused-attn|flashattn|paged` for infra experiments and A/B. That will help isolate.

perf-bot: Scheduled perf job: `fused-rope-ablation-1752001400` (runs with force_kernel override).

alex: I'll capture nsight traces for both runs and upload. Also will run with rotary_dim=128 to see scaling impact.

sree: one more thought: ALiBi vs RoPE scaling variants — if seeded scaling (scale_factor != 1.0) is used, fused-rope might be computing scale inside kernel causing extra math ops that are not vectorized. Need microbench.

maria: Good call. Try 1) fused-rope with scale precomputed in host and passed as param 2) fused-rope compute inside kernel. Compare.

jon: If precompute wins, we can change kernel ABI to accept per-layer scale_buffer ptr. Minor change, big perf win.

kevin: I'll open a small RFC for kernel ABI change and add runtime flags.

alex: TL;DR: regression is real, likely root cause is runtime kernel_select branching + memcpy due to rotary/kv layout mismatch + dynamic batching mixing requests. Plan: run forced-kernel jobs, nsight captures, add kernel_choice traces, and consider ABI change for passing precomputed scale.

maria: assign owners?

alex: I'll own the nsight captures + dataset for repro.

kevin: I'll add the runtime force flag and per-request tag.

jon: I'll prototype batch-homogenizer heuristic (simple rotary_dim+seq bucketing).

sree: I'll investigate kernel ABI change with research on fused-rope implementations (FlashAttention variants) and test math op counts.

perf-bot: Jobs queued: fused-rope-ablation-1752001400, nsight-capture-alex-1752001350.

maria: awesome. please update this thread with perf dumps. :thumbsup:
